title: Ana Mazloom Hussain
body:
ana khatilul abarra , ana khatilul atshan
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
main mohammed ka nawasa
kulle imaan mera baba
meri maa fatima zehra
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. asr-e-ashoor sare karbobala wavaila
sar khule fatima faryaad-o-buka wavaila
koi baakhi nahi qanjar ke siwa wavaila
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. main hu quran ka batin main hu kabe ka yaqin
zikr karte hai mera shaamo seher arsh nashin
main hussain ibne ali doshe mohd ka makin
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. hain mere naam se roshan ye zameen aur falak
meri khidmat ke liye khalq huwe jin-o-malak
khoon royenge mere baad sabhi hashr talak
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. karbala aun-o-mohammed hai na qasim sa jari
na habeeb hai na zoher hoor na saed-o-kalbi
hashr tak yaad rahegi yeh meri nauha giri
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. hain mere khalb mein matam ali akbar ka bapa
meri tanhai mere gham mein kare aaho buka
kissey fariyaad karu koi nahi mere siwa
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. maine inn haaton se akbar ka uthaya laasha
maine cheh mah ke bete ko abhi dafn kiya
haye gurbat ke kisi ne mujhe pursa na diya
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. kaun de dade shujath koi humsar bhi nahi
mera bhai mera abbas-e-dilawar bhi nahi
haye tanhayee meri ab mera lashkar bhi
nahi
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. asr-e-ashoor mere chahne wale na rahe
jinse roshan tha mera ghar wo ujale na rahe
rah gaye ran jo alam goud ke paale na rahe
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
9. tashnagi dhoop yeh zakhmo se jhulasta sehra
tegho khanjar liye ghere hai mujhe ahle jafa
jis taraf jaye nazar karbobala karbobala
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
10. qatl ke baad mere hogi qayamat barpa
laash paamal karenge yeh meri ahle jafa
sar mera hoga sare noke sinha wawaila
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
11. khaimaye jaan mera bimar mera jane hazeen
ek abid ke siwa koi nahi koi nahi
ab mere khoon ki pyasi hai yeh maqtal ki
zamin
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
12. main madine ka musafir main ghareebe zahra
be watan bekaso mazloom khatilul abarra
asr-e-ashoor fareed aaj bhi aati hai sada
<<MINI>>
ana mazloom hussain , ana maghmoom hussain
ana mehroom hussain , ana mazloom hussain
